text:
amanda: quick heads-up from support: a customer linked to our pricing doc and hit a 404 for the quotas anchor. also the metering SDK examples still show the old header and a legacy method name. can someone handle a small patch?
nate: can you paste the broken link?
amanda: /pricing#quotas-summary 404s after the dashboard slug rename. and /docs/metering/examples.md uses Authorization: Bearer + client.generate_text().
carla: i'll take it. plan: add a redirects.yml entry for the old pricing anchor -> new /pricing#quota-usage, update the metering examples to use x-api-key, and replace generate_text() with client.generate({...}).
kyu: please also add a one-line worked example for burst credits (support said customers want numbers). e.g., "Burst tokens used = burst_rate_per_min * burst_minutes" then a short python helper.
carla: noted. draft python helper (will put in PR): ```python
def est_burst_tokens(rate_per_min, minutes):
    return rate_per_min * minutes
# example: 1000 * 15 = 15000 tokens
```
docs-bot: PR #4522 opened by carla — "docs: pricing anchor redirect + metering SDK header + burst example". Reviewers requested: @nate, @amanda. CI: pending.
amanda: thanks. prefer redirects over in-page renames so old external links keep working. also add a changelog note.
nate: small SDK nit: show header usage explicit: headers={ 'x-api-key': RW_KEY } in both py/ts. avoid printing API key in examples.
carla: good catch, will update snippets to use env var reference. adding checklist in PR description and will backport to docs-1.2 after merge.
amanda: ping when CI passes and i'll quick QA the staging preview. :thumbsup:
carla: will do, aiming to merge today.
